CustomField.label: Allow Grouping
CustomField.description: Lets users group by this column from its menu, without the grid opening grouped by it. Picklist, checkbox, lookup, owner, date and date/time columns are offered for grouping anyway; check this for others whose values repeat, such as a text column of regions. Numbers, long text and multi-select picklists cannot be grouped.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to offer "Group by" in this column's menu, for a text column whose values repeat. Picklists, checkboxes, lookups, owners and dates are offered anyway.
